declarations.sign: Ve2 vestibular neurons (_DOs_) inhibitory, every other neuron excitatory (Vishwanathan et al. 2024, Methods).
declarations.matrix: connectome[post, pre] = synapse count, as the authors' model reads it.
declarations.position: skeleton root in EM space where a skeleton exists; atlas origins kept separately for the 609.
declarations.side: the volume covers one side of the hindbrain; sides are not distinguished.

facts.name: persistence
facts.source: the integrator holds eye position for seconds after a saccadic burst (Vishwanathan et al. 2024, Nat Neurosci 27:2340 (doi 10.1038/s41593-024-01784-3), refs 15-20 therein)
facts.predicate: after a burst to every integrator neuron, the integrator's mean activity 600 steps on is at least a quarter of its value 200 steps on

facts.name: graded
facts.source: position-encoding: persistent rates scale with eye position (Vishwanathan et al. 2024, Nat Neurosci 27:2340 (doi 10.1038/s41593-024-01784-3), Fig. 5)
facts.predicate: held levels for bursts 0.01, 0.03, 0.1 increase strictly; held(0.03)/held(0.1) in [0.2, 0.8]; held(0.01)/held(0.1) in [0.05, 0.5]

facts.name: two modes
facts.source: two weakly coupled three-block cycles, two leading eigenvalues (Vishwanathan et al. 2024, Nat Neurosci 27:2340 (doi 10.1038/s41593-024-01784-3), Fig. 4)
facts.predicate: the states held after a burst to submodule 1 and after a burst to submodule 2 have cosine at most 0.9

facts.name: motor submodule reads out to ABD motor
facts.source: one submodule connects preferentially to ABD_M (Vishwanathan et al. 2024, Nat Neurosci 27:2340 (doi 10.1038/s41593-024-01784-3), Fig. 3)
facts.predicate: after a burst to submodule 1, the held mean of ABD_m exceeds that of ABD_i

facts.name: internuclear submodule reads out to ABD internuclear
facts.source: the other submodule connects preferentially to ABD_I (Vishwanathan et al. 2024, Nat Neurosci 27:2340 (doi 10.1038/s41593-024-01784-3), Fig. 3)
facts.predicate: after a burst to submodule 2, the held mean of ABD_i exceeds that of ABD_m

facts.name: vestibular push
facts.source: Ve2 neurons are inhibitory and carry primary vestibular input into the integrator (Vishwanathan et al. 2024, Nat Neurosci 27:2340 (doi 10.1038/s41593-024-01784-3), Methods)
facts.predicate: a burst to the Ve2 neurons during a held state lowers the integrator's mean 200 steps later by at least ten percent against the undisturbed hold

facts.name: concentration of sensitivity
facts.source: imaged eye-position sensitivities of 605 generic integrator cells: the top decile carries 0.36 of the total (slopesThresh_09102020.csv of goldman-lab/Connectome-Model)
facts.predicate: in the held state after a burst to every integrator neuron, the top decile of integrator neurons carries between 0.30 and 0.42 of the integrator's total activity

facts.name: abducens participation
facts.source: imaged ABD cells have higher sensitivities than generic cells (median 7.8 against 5.1, same table)
facts.predicate: in the held state after a burst to every integrator neuron, the mean activity of ABD_m and of ABD_i each exceeds the integrator mean

explored.H2: the eigenvalue ratio of permuted and matched nulls was looked at before the freeze
explored.H5: the top-decile share of permuted and matched nulls was looked at before the freeze
